hooks.command: echo 'Taskflow reminder: run /review-changes on staged work before committing.'

root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR%/}"; jq -e --arg root "$root" '(.tool_input.file_path // "") as $p | (($p | contains("/legacy/")) and ($root == "" or ($p | startswith($root + "/")))) | not' >/dev/null; s=$?; if [ $s -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; elif [ $s -eq 1 ]; then echo 'refused: legacy/ is the migration rollback artifact — read-only forever' >&2; exit 2; else echo "legacy-guard hook error (jq exit $s — jq missing or bad input); blocking write, fix the hook" >&2; exit 2; fi
